_about: Hand fixes for items that touch on a sheet. Boxes are [x, y, w, h] on the full-resolution sheet. split = cut one connected blob along the box; merge = group every component the box touches into one sprite; drop = throw away components mostly inside the box.

sheet-jungle-trees._split_why: row gaps only: the owner's rows are separated by clear green bands; no vertical boxes (they cut canopies and fronds, audit round 3)

_note_resources_08: resources_08 is ONE art item: a leafy plant with its root ball knot and a bunch of red fruit hanging from the same stem bundle. The audit asked for a split at the waist; tried (bands at y 735/776/780/806), but the fruit bunch carries its own big green leaves, so the cut produces a two-material item (green leaf rim over dark red fruit) that reads wrong in game and fails the part-green edge check. Kept whole and named berry_palm (MangoBush).

sheet-tall-grasses._why: clump rows only (y 280-650): auto_welds() partitions thin welds where two clumps share blades, keeping every pixel; the iso tiles (top) and big ground patches (bottom) stay whole
